ov: A large, plain-coated cat of the Americas, also called puma, mountain lion and panther. It can purr, but it can’t roar.

why.dg: Attacks on people are very rare. They usually involve a young or starving cougar, or one that has got used to people.

rg: The widest range of any wild land animal in the Americas, from the Yukon in Canada to the southern Andes.
df: Mainly deer; also smaller mammals such as rodents, rabbits and raccoons.

cf.tip: Lions are much bigger, live in Africa and India, and have a tufted tail; males have a mane.
Jaguars are heavily spotted and stockier; an adult cougar has no spots.

fx: Despite its size, it belongs to the same branch of the cat family as the house cat, not to the roaring big cats. It is the largest cat that can purr.
